data.body: RP-01 combined ticket/test behavioral research is complete and remains Phase-4 clarification, not implementation. Artifacts: .joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-research.md; .joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-probe.py; qualified recovery ledger: .joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md. Probe command: env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python .joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-probe.py. Result: PASS as an offline in-process integration probe; it asserted pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.2, offline=true, and produced 23/23 declared observations (11 returned outcomes and 12 expected error outcomes) using real Agent, PromptedOutput, NativeOutput, FallbackModel, UsageLimits, Hooks, ProcessHistory, and FunctionModel seams with no live model call. Current-Rebar regression evidence: 407 passed across 22 focused test modules in two runs (266 + 141); two non-failing Pydantic event-loop deprecation warnings. Coverage totals: 38 deduplicated behavior-matrix rows; 15 historical ticket aliases plus ADR 0056; 23 upstream-seam experiments; 407 existing tests. Material deltas are explicitly queued rather than inherited: request-budget semantics, retry-message wire shape, successful-retry usage aggregation, output-exhaustion exception translation, and underlying failed-attempt accounting. Highest-impact next decision: whether Pydantic output retries share one operation-wide request_limit with tool turns, or retain the current prompted path behavior where each manual output attempt starts a fresh Agent run and receives a fresh request budget.
